title: GIRAFE: Glottal Imaging Dataset for Advanced Segmentation, Analysis, and Facilitative Playbacks Evaluation
why_promising: Primary clinical voice-production resource: 65 high-speed videoendoscopic sustained-vowel recordings from 50 patients; repository documentation states every recording was manually annotated by an expert with semantic masks of the glottal gap. Zenodo reports 502 frames per sequence (32,630 images total), 4,000 fps acquisition, clinical/control metadata, and sustained-vowel phonation including some onsets.
open_question: Zenodo record is publicly visible but files are currently restricted. Obtain lawful file access before core ingestion; then inventory every recording/mask/metadata object, preserve frame-level manual masks and health/equipment metadata, and distinguish human masks from supplied automatic segmentations.
